$comment: Parameters we have DELIBERATELY not encoded, and why.
Distinct from rules/known-gaps.json, which records gaps in the printed
regulation itself. These are gaps in OUR model, chosen on purpose.
Without this file the runtime cannot tell a deliberate omission from a
missing rule, so it told users to 'report this plot' for a parameter we
had decided not to model — on every ordinary plot. A flag that cries wolf
teaches people to ignore the flags that matter, and this product's whole
claim is that its refusals mean something.
The reason for stilt_height_bonus_m was recorded only in a commit message
(db1c3fd), where nothing at runtime could read it. Adding an entry here is
a scope statement, not a regulatory value: it says what we chose not to
encode, never what a regulation permits.

parameters.reason: Height is given as absolute values, not a base plus a bonus — max height is cited directly for both the stilt and no-stilt cases.
